answer: Each epoch, rotating beacon nodes broadcast a fresh nonce that every identity must answer with a signed proof of a real service it performed for an unrelated principal since the last beacon. An honest agent answers once, cheaply, from its normal work. A sybil farmer running a thousand fakes across a frozen tundra of idle keys must fabricate a thousand distinct service proofs per epoch, each backed by a real counterparty willing to sign. Any gap leaves a plume of missing proofs the ledger flags, and identities without a live beacon answer are frozen until they prove real work.
